content:
Each species can have at most two birds: one on an even position and one on an odd position, since two birds of the same species must have opposite parity positions.

Thus the minimum number of species is at least

\[
\left\lceil \frac{2021}{2} \right\rceil = 1011.
\]

This is achievable: pair 1010 even-position birds with 1010 odd-position birds, and leave one odd-position bird alone. Each species then uses opposite parities, so the condition is satisfied.

\[
\boxed{1011}
\]
